notes.ocean.land_fraction: A world parameter chosen by the user (2026-10-16), not a calibration: the share of the planet's surface (0 to 1, cells weighted by the cosine of their latitude) above sea level. terrain.terraforming places the sea level at the base elevation that leaves this share above it, once, right after the tectonics (procedural-world only: the imported recipes take the sea from the map, the tectonics recipe keeps the engine's level); no connectivity rule: the share counts every cell above the level, and a closed basin below it is below sea like any other cell (terrain.inland_seas keeps it; the lake stages after the erosion decide what it holds). 0 keeps the sea level the tectonic engine leaves (its land fraction is an outcome of the run, about 35 % at seed 1 after 600 Myr; the engine's sea_level key sets only the initial ocean coverage). The default 0.292 is the user's choice (2026-10-16), Earth's present land fraction as the sum of the rounded land bands of ETOPO 2022 at 2048 columns with spherical weights (8.0 + 8.2 + 5.4 + 4.4 + 1.7 + 1.5 %); the unrounded share of that grid above 0 m is 29.0 %. The workbench's sea-level slider wins when it asks for a level other than the tectonics'. Default 0 (off, the engine sea level) since 2026-10-16: at 0.292 (Earth, ETOPO 2048) the sea placed at terraforming flooded the continents' low interiors behind higher rims (annular continents, inland seas) and the coast cleanup after it cut the land to 25.5 %; the Earth-like land fraction waits for Earth-like continental freeboard (terrain roadmap T4.12).
